mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP450 enzymes and may increase zidovudine metabolism via alternative pathways, potentially altering AZT exposure; additionally, both drugs can cause peripheral neuropathy and hepatotoxicity.
action: Monitor for increased zidovudine toxicity (neuropathy, hepatotoxicity); consider alternative antiretroviral agents or adjust zidovudine dosing; counsel on avoiding alcohol given disulfiram mechanism.
